title: CVAT (Computer Vision Annotation Tool) — What CVAT does
description: CVAT — the Computer Vision Annotation Tool — is the open-source standard for labeling images and video for computer vision: boxes, polygons, masks, skeletons, and tracks. Born at Intel, it now thrives as an independent open project.
